name: @gymmap/ui
//: Consumed as SOURCE, not as build output — Next.js transpilePackages and Vite both compile workspace TS directly. A dist/ step here would add a build edge to every front-end change for no benefit. That is also why the source imports carry `.ts` extensions: allowImportingTsExtensions is on in the react preset, and Node 22's type stripping resolves them for the token scripts.
//lint: R1a keeps the ROOT devDependencies to seven packages, and eslint is not one of them - so each workspace that lints declares its own runner. @gymmap/config is deliberately ABSENT here: DesignSystem.md 2.4 puts the Tailwind preset re-export in packages/config, which makes config depend on ui, and turbo refuses the resulting build cycle. The shared rule set still reaches this package - eslint walks up to the root eslint.config.mjs, which resolves ./packages/config/eslint/index.mjs by relative path and needs no dependency edge.
